create.name: Commune
create.bio:
Commune is an online school for inner and outer wellbeing, run from Topanga in the hills above Los Angeles. Its co-founder and chief executive, Jeff Krasno, earlier helped start the Wanderlust yoga festivals, and Commune grew out of the same idea: bring well-known teachers to people who could never get to them, this time through filmed courses rather than live gatherings.

The catalogue runs to well over a hundred video courses, each made with one teacher or a small group, and is sorted into four strands: Practice (yoga, meditation, breathwork and tapping), Growth (spiritual and personal development), Impact (mindful leadership, regeneration and civic life) and a Health strand. Teachers have included Marianne Williamson, Sadhguru, Byron Katie, Sharon Salzberg, Jack Kornfield and Adriene Mishler. A course can be bought outright, or the whole library opened through a yearly membership that adds daily practices, live member gatherings and a phone app. For deeper study, Communiversity runs five-week trainings in subjects such as qigong, yoga teaching and dharma talks on presence. Krasno also hosts the weekly Commune Podcast, a long-running series of conversations with teachers, thinkers and scientists.

courses.title: Commune Courses
courses.description: Commune's library of filmed courses, each built with one teacher: week-long meditation series, multi-part workshops on spiritual basics and relationships, yoga programmes and more. Each course can be bought once and kept, and many come with transcripts and a companion app.

courses.title: Commune Membership
courses.description: One yearly plan that opens the whole course library, over a thousand short daily practices, live gatherings for members, a private community and the Commune app. A 14-day free trial comes first.

courses.title: Communiversity
courses.description: Commune's online academy of five-week trainings for going deeper into one subject, with recorded lessons and, on some courses, live calls. Current trainings include qigong and the Five Phases with Mimi Kuo-Deemer, yoga teaching with Schuyler Grant and dharma talks with Scott Schwenk.

free_resources.title: Commune Podcast
free_resources.description: A free weekly conversation hosted by Jeff Krasno with teachers, spiritual leaders, scientists and storytellers, now several hundred episodes deep. It is also on Apple Podcasts and Spotify.

free_resources.title: Commune on YouTube
free_resources.description: Free clips, talks and full practices from Commune teachers, including yoga flows and guided meditations.
